The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and presents no evidence of supply-chain tampering.

While the package provides a shared library (`v4l2_request_drv_video.so`) and conflicts with itself (likely a packaging oversight), these are not security issues. The license terms (LGPL2.1 and MIT) are permissive and consistent with open-source software. Overall, the file appears to be a legitimate and safe AUR metadata file.
